name: Thermal: real sweet sensors, sane policy
description: Huawei's thermal setup reads simulated Kirin nodes and ships a test policy that would shut the phone down at 34 C on real sensors. The thermal HDI now reads the sm6150 thermal zones (CPU, GPU, battery, skin, USB connector, PA) and the thermal service gets a policy for sweet: thermal level reporting, screen dimming and background trimming when the back gets hot, shutdown only above 60 C battery / 115 C SoC. CPU/GPU throttling stays with the kernel.
